description: I am K2 Nova - a solo explorer from Gilgit Baltistan, Pakistan. From the highest mountains on Earth to space, I am exploring Earth System trends using NASA data, maths, and storytelling. My mission is to show how our planet is changing and what it means for mountain communities.
summary:
K2 NOVA is my idea for a smart early warning system to protect villages in Gilgit-Baltistan from glacial lake floods. In our northern areas, lakes can burst suddenly and destroy homes in minutes, with no time for people to escape.

I belong to Gilgit-Baltistan, so I have seen this trend with my own eyes. My proposed system will monitor the water level of the lake.
When the water reaches a critical level, it will sound a loud siren in the village and send a mobile alert to villagers. Green means safe, Yellow means get ready, and Red means leave the village immediately. 

This idea is important because one early alert can save a whole village. It will give families at least one hour to move to a safe place and save lives, homes, and animals.
details:
K2 NOVA - Early GLOF Warning System

K2 NOVA is a low-cost, early warning system designed to save lives in remote villages of Pakistan.

How does it work?

It will use NASA satellite data, river water-level sensors, and rainfall data to predict floods before they happen. My system will use a simple 3-level alert system: Green = Safe: Normal water level. No danger.

Yellow = Get Ready: Water level is rising. A mobile alert is sent to villagers to prepare and keep important things safe.

Red = Evacuate Now: Dangerous flood coming. A loud village siren sounds AND a mobile alert is sent to evacuate the village immediately.

Why is it creative?

In many villages, mobile networks fail during floods and people do not have smartphones. That is why my system has two parts: Sensors will be installed near the glacier to check the water level, and a loud siren will be installed in the village. When water rises to a dangerous level, the sensor will send a wireless radio signal to the village siren, which sounds loudly to warn everyone. Even if the phone is off, the siren can be heard by everyone. It is simple, cheap, and works without internet.

Impact:

My goal is to provide early warning to villagers to move to safe places, save their families, livestock, and belongings. This can save hundreds of lives every year in Gilgit-Baltistan Pakistan.

Tools & Technology I Plan to Use:

As a solo participant, I designed this project using research and planning tools. I have not built the hardware yet.

Hardware I Will Use in Future:

In the future, I will use an Ultrasonic Water-Level Sensor near the glacier, a Temperature Sensor to detect sudden glacier melting, and a Solar-Powered System so it works even without electricity.

Communication System I Will Use:

I plan to use a LoRa (Long Range Radio) Module to send signals from the glacier sensor to the village siren (up to 20km), plus a GSM Mobile Alert System as a backup.
